coverage_update.notes: 103 accepted, 5 pending work packages, 5 unresolved, 1 merged, 4 rejected. This run added 15 incidents: 7 Israeli/Israeli-security targets including Route 60/Karmei Tzur/Almog shootings and four road attacks; 8 Palestinian-target settler incidents including Imatin/Azzun, Huwwara/Madama/Yitzhar, Beit Iskariya/Efrat/Ma'on. Almog exact Kan original recovered; stable preview pending. Palestinian/local residual backlog remains.

candidate_updates.resolution_notes: Progress: unitized four strongest/displayable road attacks as ILPV-2023-0102..0105 (Yakir bus with children; Aqraba Junction 2 soldiers injured; Migdalim-Aqraba 2 Israelis injured; Einav windshield). Remainder of large Jan24-26 wave still needs reconciliation/decision rather than bulk acceptance.
candidate_updates.media_status: Exact ITIC image leads for ILPV-2023-0103 and ILPV-2023-0105; stable extraction pending

candidate_updates.resolution_notes: Progress: accepted Huwwara gunfire ILPV-2023-0108, Madama home attack ILPV-2023-0109, and Jan26 Yitzhar-bypass stones ILPV-2023-0110. Residual Jan27-31 Nablus/Qalqiliya/Salfit dated events (Deir Sharaf, Beit Furik, Jit/Yasuf etc.) remain to unitize/dedupe.

Progress: accepted Beit Iskariya assault ILPV-2023-0111, Efrat pepper spray ILPV-2023-0112, and Ma'on pepper spray ILPV-2023-0113. Kisan and additional Jan27-31 Bethlehem/Hebron road/property/assault events remain.
Progress: accepted Imatin/Amateen tree attack ILPV-2023-0106 (WAFA/NAD date-count discrepancy preserved) and Azzun trees ILPV-2023-0107. Earlier residual land/road/home events remain to resolve.
candidate_updates.media_status: WAFA article image lead for Imatin; provenance/exactness check pending

candidate_updates.resolution_notes: Progress: unitized/accepted Route60 bus shooting ILPV-2023-0099, Karmei Tzur shooting ILPV-2023-0100 and Almog restaurant shooting ILPV-2023-0101.
